summary: Implemented the window title control. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and Control.title(title), passing a single two-item code; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False, with the required docstring caveats; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (per instructions), so black, mypy, and pytest are unverified; new test lines were checked by reading to be within 88 columns. No commits were made.
